context.alert_text: Errors on the database secret rotation function above 0

root_cause.hypothesis: The warden-dev-db-rotator Lambda is failing during its Secrets Manager rotation calls (AddSecretVersionStage/UpdateSecretVersionStage against the target secret) with AccessDeniedException, indicating the function's execution role (or the secret's resource policy) lacks the required Secrets Manager/KMS permissions for rotation. This produces the 2 Lambda errors that tripped the Errors alarm, not a code regression (no recent deploy/config change).
evidence: C2: no change in 6h rules out a bad deploy
F5: rotation API tokens/SecretId referenced in the same log window
ruled_out: Code deploy regression (C2 shows no change)
Memory/timeout exhaustion (M6 duration 1840ms well under 30s timeout, memory used ~85MB of 128MB)

citations.quote: none on warden-dev-db-rotator in the 6 h before the alert

proposal.reasoning: The errors stem from an AccessDeniedException during Secrets Manager rotation calls, implying an IAM permissions gap on the rotation role or secret resource policy. None of the automated remediation actions (restart, scale, rollback, config revert, etc.) can fix an IAM/permissions boundary issue, and changing IAM policy is outside the deterministic verifier's safe-action set, so this needs human review of the role/secret policy.
proposal.expected_effect: A human reviews and corrects the Lambda execution role or secret resource policy permissions, resolving the AccessDeniedException and clearing the Errors alarm.
